propositions: rebar transition close prints lock timeout error to stderr with exit code 0 after the close has durably committed, silently dropping the completion signature
the signing tail runs after the STATUS event commits and releases the lock, so transient lock timeouts during signing are unreportable to the caller
close_ticket returns no field about signature outcome, making the loss undetectable programmatically across library, CLI, and MCP boundaries

completion_signature payload with {signed, cause, error} must be threaded through _lib_writes.transition, CLI --output json, TransitionResult TypedDict, and transition_result.schema.json so all three public surfaces carry the marker
idea-to-closed transitions and --force closes must report completion_signature with appropriate cause values (force_bypassed and absent respectively) without inventing false completion records
